name: Staff login opens the seller dashboard

planSteps.description: Sign in with the configured local TestSprite admin credentials.
Verify authentication succeeds and the user reaches the authenticated seller dashboard rather than remaining on the login page.
Verify Overview, Bookings, Customers, and Sessions sections are available and the page renders without an error state.
Open the seller dashboard's customer booking or session workflow.
Verify the authenticated staff user can see the seller workflow controls and that the browser has an HTTP-only staff session cookie.
